news.title: Bitcoin Surges On Treasury Game-Changer; Strategy Raises $2 Bil
news.summary: The bitcoin price continued its recent surge on Monday, touching a two-month high on news that the Treasury Department might conduct its own version of quantitative easing using its nearly $1 trillion general account.  The rally got cooking with a burst of short-covering last Wednesday, when Treasury announced that it would at least double buybacks of long-term government bonds to stem a big rise in 10- and 30-year Treasury yields.  The moves by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent are both part of an effort to rein in government borrowing costs and the economic fallout of high rates.
